content.short: Ownerfy provides a multi-user, multi-contract NFT minting platform for projects and apps with no crypto needed.
content.description: Ownerfy's minting API is plug-and-play, designed for teams who don't want to learn Solidity or manage crypto. It enables apps to mint and transfer NFTs and interact with smart contracts using familiar development skills, without bearing the liabilities of holding cryptocurrency. Ownerfy uses a proprietary co-custodial private key solution backed by MPC security, providing secure access without exposing private keys and enabling scalable NFT experiences with reduced crypto risk.
content.meta: Ownerfy is an NFT minting platform with multi-user, multi-contract support and no crypto needed. Discover Ownerfy and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
